label: B25-BRAM-CORE-MICROBENCH-COREMARK
title: Implement the BRAM-resident CPU correctness microbench and CoreMark port
writes: rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_pkg.sv and exact PLAT_STATUS cycle-counter region only if required
rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_top.sv exact cycle-counter/status wiring region only if required
rtl/lcvex_l1_d_wb.sv exact simultaneous probe/upstream ready arbitration region
tb/sv exact status/cycle-counter and B25 SoC microbench regions
tb/sv/lcvex_l1_d_wb_tb.sv exact simultaneous probe/upstream acceptance test
scope: Add t/v/c monitor commands, deterministic signatures, an offline-vendored official CoreMark port and a trustworthy 25 MHz cycle measurement. Preserve p/?/m/d/echo and the 64 KiB image/stack contract.

L0: official CoreMark seed/CRC and license/provenance checks
L1: cycle counter reset/read-only/monotonic tests if added
L2: full B25 SoC from PC=0 executes t and v from the same image and returns to monitor

acceptance: Correctness suite and CoreMark short validation pass from one 64 KiB image; standard c mode computes score only from a monotonic 25 MHz cycle source and enforces official CRC/seed plus >=10 seconds; affected L0-L2 and existing monitor commands pass.
forbidden_regions: DDR dependency for t/v/c working data
host wall time as CoreMark timer
claiming a valid score from short self-check
disabling assertions or changing expected CRC

dispatch.monitoring: direct local implementation; no GamePC or hardware access

completion.merged_l0: PASS reproducible build, host oracle, parser negatives and port audit
completion.merged_l2: PASS full B25 SoC t/v and transcript parsers
